2493-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2493-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

643-4863-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-4863-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

69-539-3172-3181.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Krosan Restorer do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-3172-3181.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Krosan Restorer does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional land without summoning sickness.
69-539-3172-3181.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping itself at least one other nonsummoning sick land.
Activate the land, adding {1}.
Repeat.
69-539-3172-3181.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

4289-4687-5115.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
4289-4687-5115.description:
Activate Cryptolith Rite by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-4247-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
628-4247-6972.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

3020-4247-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
3020-4247-6701.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1563-3899-4460-7824.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
2292-6972-7804.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Captain Kathryn Janeway.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Captain Kathryn Janeway enters, it triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Kathryn Janeway.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1409-3099-3755-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1409-3099-3755-4068.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1846-2092-4954.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2
1846-2092-4954.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

2974-4377-5131.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
2974-4377-5131.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Repository Skaab either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repository Skaab's second ability triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

413-586-5258-5618-7646.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and  sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {B}{B}{B} and untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater
with a film counter on it

57-4846-6924-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6924-7296.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1525-4254-6913-7115-7117.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland card in hand.
You have not resolved either a firebending ability, a waterbending ability, and/or an airbending ability this turn.
1525-4254-6913-7115-7117.description:
Cast any spell by paying {0} due to Jodah and Aang, Master of Elements.
Toph triggers, earthbending a land.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card and put it into your hand due to Abundance.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1, and repeat from step 1 as able.
1525-4254-6913-7115-7117.notes: You need to have both an Avatar Aang and an Aang, Master of Elements on the battlefield. This combo only reduces the mana cost of spells to {0} - it doesn't negate additional costs or targets those spells may require.

Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

414-4613-6461.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-4613-6461.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
When the Insect enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Insect. This causes it to gain Grist's abilities due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Spider you control without summoning sickness
attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

1006-1729-2178.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Wolfhunter's Quiver attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

500-1181-5913.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Pinnacle Monk and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Pinnacle Monk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Pinnacle Monk token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.

1274-5641-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-5641-6097.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

969-1563-2457-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

632-1115-3621-4659-5129.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-1115-3621-4659-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

3560-5256-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3560-5256-5972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

341-1525-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

372-4284-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Clone.
372-4284-4681.description:
Cast Clone by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Clone's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Clone ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Clone leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Clone into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

2595-4929-5224.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing creatures that enter the battlefield under your control this turn to enter with a +1/+1 counter on them.
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {0}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Together Forever, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

628-5523-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1
Repeat.

2703-2713-2816-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Myr Propagator.
Myr Propagator does not have summoning sickness.
2703-2713-2816-4659.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr Propagator token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

914-5128-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Dockside Extortionist has a sticker on it.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5128-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power.
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Repeat.

306-2556-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying {4}{U}.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your next upkeep on your extra turn, Cache Raiders triggers, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
